name: Amane Wagashi
description: An elegant, quiet store theme for a small Kyoto-style wagashi (Japanese confectionery) house that makes a different sweet each month, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Blush washi paper, pale azuki panels, deep azuki-brown ink and a muted azuki red; Kaisei Tokumin for display, Plus Jakarta Sans for text. A magazine masthead (H5) with a quiet dateline that shows the season of the site's own calendar (Late autumn · Month of the chestnut, from the WordPress timezone through a block binding), the house name in large type beside a small round azuki seal and a ruled menu row. The home page is built around a sideways-scrolling seasonal tray (L4): twelve months of sweets, January camellia to December yuzu, each a framed card with photograph, month, name, note and price, scroll-snap, keyboard and touch scrollable, plain-anchor earlier/later and month links, this month marked In season now. Seasonal calendar (all twelve months as a grid) and Pre-orders pages (choose a box, pick a day, collect or delivery; editable Most chosen badge), plus shop, about, journal, newsletter and contact. The footer (F6) is a street sketch with one pin beside a quiet visit and pre-order card. The shop address, hours, telephone, email and pre-order cut-off are one synced pattern (masthead dateline, footer card, Pre-orders, Contact); the twelve sweets with prices are one synced pattern (home tray, Shop, Seasonal calendar). WooCommerce optional: without it the shop shows the tray and orders go by telephone or email.
deviation: Footer switched from the planned F7 to F6 (map + address card), decided by the orchestrator: Yohaku Studio already uses H5+F7; H5+F6+L4 is unused, and neighbours #10 Koke Garden (H4/F9/L8) and #12 Suzuri Shodo (H12/F11/L5) stay adjacent-safe. F6 differs from Sumai Realty, Tabi Note and Tsumiki Accounting by a quiet street sketch (inline SVG: river, the old stone bridge, two streets, one azuki pin) on a pale azuki panel beside a rice-paper visit and pre-order card fed by the synced shop details, then a ruled centred menu row; no CTA band. H5 differs from Oto Radio, Sushi Ginza and Yohaku Studio by a dateline whose season words come from the site's WordPress timezone (block binding amane-wagashi/season, never the visitor clock), a centred Kaisei Tokumin house name beside a CSS azuki seal and a double-ruled menu row; at 390 px the name stays on one line and the menu becomes Menu + cart. L4 differs from Kinu Kimono (rack on a gold rail) and Kiroku Studio (case reel) by framed rice-paper cards standing on a pale azuki tray board with a wooden edge, a twelve-month anchor index and the current month marked server-side. Palette as planned plus rice #FBF8F6 cards, hairline #CDB5AE, quiet brown #6A5450 and deep azuki #6E3F3B for small text and links. AA: ink #3A2826 12.2:1 on washi, 9.5:1 on pale azuki; muted azuki #8E5A55 4.9:1 on washi (AA) but 3.8:1 on pale azuki, so it is kept to large type, marks, prices on rice and the seal; deep azuki #6E3F3B 7.6:1 on washi, 5.9:1 on pale azuki; quiet #6A5450 6.2:1 on washi, 4.8:1 on pale azuki. Kaisei Tokumin and Plus Jakarta Sans verified OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name (google/fonts ofl/kaiseitokumin, ofl/plusjakartasans OFL.txt); Kaisei Tokumin Regular + Medium subset to Latin (the CJK font is ~4.5 MB each, ~20 KB as Latin WOFF2), Plus Jakarta Sans limited to wght 300-600 and subset (~62 KB fonts in total). Industry wagashi and page tags seasonal-calendar and pre-orders are new. The confectioner portrait reuses a crop when its photograph is missing. Newsletter page added because check-themes requires it.
